title.notes: Crawl4AI is the leading open-source LLM-friendly web crawler — 58K+ GitHub stars, #1 GitHub trending when launched. Core value: converts complex websites into clean Markdown or structured JSON optimized for LLM consumption (95%+ better extraction accuracy vs raw HTML). v0.8.x features: async Python library, CSS/XPath extraction (deterministic, fast, free), LLM-based extraction (for irregular pages — pass schema, LLM extracts), BM25 query filtering (extract only content relevant to your query), BFS deep crawling (breadth-first site traversal), chunking strategies (topic-based, regex, sentence-level), JS execution support, PDF/screenshot generation, Playwright integration for dynamic pages. Two extraction modes: JsonCssExtractionStrategy (schema-based CSS selectors, fast + deterministic) vs LLMExtractionStrategy (intelligent parsing for unstructured content, any LLM including Ollama for free). RAG integration: crawl → chunk → embed → vector store in one pipeline. Developer guide: async crawler setup (Python 3.11+, async/await), CSS extraction schema design, LLM extraction with structured output (Pydantic models), BM25 filtering for targeted content, combining with Airbyte for scheduled crawl-to-vector-store pipelines, cost optimization (CSS extraction is free, LLM extraction costs vary by model), anti-blocking patterns (proxies, rate limits, cookies). KD 5, SV 280.
